scope: taxonomy-only; existing canonical Poaceae learner species; no installation, photo, genus, range or Pages edits

scientific_decisions.reason: POWO/WCVP accepts the species in Poaceae, combination published Brittonia 26:59 (1974); existing canonical binomial is correct. No renaming.
POWO/WCVP accepts separate species rank, Brittonia 26:60 (1974); author is Gould, not (Vasey) Gould. Existing canonical binomial is correct.
POWO lists original 1824 combination as homotypic synonym of accepted D. commutatum.
POWO lists as homotypic synonym but marks the 1854 name illegitimate and superfluous; preserve nomenclatural qualifier.
POWO lists the 1889 basionym as the sole homotypic synonym. It explicitly distinguishes Vasey's plant name from Saporta's earlier 1861 fossil name; do not strip the author/fossil-name caution.
POWO/WCVP accepts as a separate species, not part of modern D. commutatum sensu stricto.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Dichanthelium commutatum subsp. ashei (T.G.Pearson ex Ashe) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists 2002 subspecies combination as homotypic synonym of separate D. ashei.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Dichanthelium commutatum var. ashei (T.G.Pearson ex Ashe) Mohlenbr.
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO maps the historical 1985 variety to separate accepted D. ashei; do not use as automatic synonym of modern D. commutatum.
POWO accepts species rank; combination published Phytologia 102:173 (2020). Distinct from D. commutatum.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Dichanthelium commutatum subsp. equilaterale (Scribn.) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists the 2002 subspecies as homotypic synonym of accepted D. equilaterale.
POWO accepts species rank, first published as current combination Erigenia 6:26 (1985); not modern D. commutatum.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Dichanthelium commutatum subsp. joorii (Vasey) Freckmann & Lelong
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO lists historical subspecies as homotypic synonym of D. joorii, along with Panicum commutatum var. joorii and Panicum joorii.
POWO accepts species rank; combination published Phytologia 102:174 (2020). Distinct from D. commutatum.
POWO lists historical Panicum name as homotypic synonym of separately accepted D. mutabile; ITIS still groups it under D. commutatum.
POWO accepts distinct species rank; modern species boundary must be respected.
POWO lists this 1896 variety as homotypic synonym of D. consanguineum, not D. commutatum.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Assertion: all ITIS/NWPL synonyms grouped under Dichanthelium commutatum are synonyms of the same accepted POWO species
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: Dichanthelium commutatum sensu stricto only for verified POWO mappings
scientific_decisions.reason: The blanket merge is false under current POWO/WCVP: ITIS and the February 2026 USACE NWPL retain broad synonym lists containing D. ashei, D. joorii, D. equilaterale and D. mutabile concepts that POWO separates. FAIL applies to the blanket mapping assertion, not to either accepted learner name.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical observations and herbarium specimens identified as Dichanthelium commutatum sensu lato or Panicum commutatum sensu lato
scientific_decisions.reason: Older broad-concept records lacking a complete name, rank, author and diagnostic specimen cannot be assigned reliably to D. commutatum s.s. or a modern segregate. Preserve source determinations and require specimen-level re-examination.

Three source-labelled photos exist but the canonical card says diagnostic leaf base/collar and measured mature spikelets are not demonstrated in a same-plant sequence. Accepted-name PASS does not independently confirm photographed specimens or exclude modern segregates.

Canonical card has provisional photos and no verified same-plant leaf/collar and measured spikelet evidence. Name and synonym PASS cannot certify specimen-level ID or distinguish visually similar rosette grasses.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid or introgression status of individual Dichanthelium commutatum / pedicellatum learner plants
scientific_decisions.reason: The 2024 phylogenetic study reports putative hybridization in some Dichanthelium lineages but does not prove hybrid ancestry of either learner photograph set; no hybrid determination is made.

cross_species_boundary_warning: Do not auto-map historical commutatum subspecies/varieties or broad ITIS/NWPL synonym lists to current D. commutatum; exact epithet, rank, author and original specimen concept control the mapping.
followup: Keep both canonical learner species unchanged. Send historical commutatum s.l. observations to specimen-level concept review, retain provisional photo identity holds. Do not install segregate taxa from this evidence.
